items.originalTitle: Helmut Marko invests in AI start-up after Red Bull F1 exit
detailZh: 赫尔穆特·马尔科在红牛F1退出后投资了人工智能初创公司
前红牛顾问赫尔穆特·马尔科投资了一家奥地利人工智能初创公司
马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队、赫尔穆特·马尔科、红牛车队
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前红牛赛车运动顾问赫尔穆特·马克奥成为了一家奥地利人工智能初创公司的投资者，该公司允许人们留下个人信息，在亲人去世后传达给他们。
这位83岁的老人在去年赛季结束后，结束了他在米尔顿凯恩斯车队超过二十年的职业生涯，于10月20日在维也纳曼德勒东方酒店举办的启动仪式上被公布为Lebensstimmen GmbH的支持者。
这家总部位于格拉茨的公司将在国际上以Words That Remain的名义运营，其平台被描述为一种数字化的临终规划。用户在生前录制或写下信息，然后在去世后传递给指定的接收者。
该公司还提供了一种工具，帮助悲伤的家庭整理自己的话语，并推出了一款名为“Fabertar”的人工智能悼词撰写者，该软件与维也纳圣斯蒂芬大教堂的牧师托尼·法贝尔共同开发。Lebensstimmen表示，“Fabertar”明确标明为AI，并不旨在取代神父或演讲者，而是帮助那些无人可用的情况。
马克奥，他建立了红牛的青训项目，并帮助四位冠军车手塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔和马克斯·维斯塔潘成长，将这次投资与他自己在赛车界的职业生涯联系起来。
"赛车运动从未留给运气；它通过不断使用新技术来造福人们的勇气而得到改进。这正是我在Lebensstimmen中认识到的态度，马克奥在新闻稿中说。
这家公司由Philipp Berkessy、Markus Pinter和Lukas Stern创立，并计划在2027年第一季度在奥地利和国际上全面推出其平台。
"每个人都有应该保留的话语。通过Lebensstimmen，我们首次使临终规划变得个性化、数字化和合法化。今天，一种新的告别文化开始了，它始于奥地利，"Berkessy说。
detailEn: Helmut Marko invests in AI start-up after Red Bull F1 exit
Former Red Bull adviser Helmut Marko has invested in an Austrian AI start-up
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Helmut Marko, Red Bull Racing
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Red Bull motorsport adviser Helmut Marko has become an investor in an Austrian artificial intelligence start-up that lets people leave personal messages to be delivered to loved ones after they die.

The 83-year-old, who stepped down from his role at the Milton Keynes outfit at the end of last season after more than two decades with the company, was unveiled as a backer of Lebensstimmen GmbH at a launch event at the Mandarin Oriental hotel in Vienna on 20 October.

The Graz-based company, which will operate internationally under the name Words That Remain, describes its platform as a form of digital end-of-life planning. Users record or write messages during their lifetime, which are then passed on to chosen recipients after their death.

The company also offers a tool to help grieving families put their own words together and has launched an AI eulogist called the "Fabertar", developed with Toni Faber, the cathedral pastor of St Stephen's in Vienna. Lebensstimmen says the "Fabertar" is clearly labelled as AI and is not designed to replace priests or speakers, but to help where none are available.
Marko, who built Red Bull's junior programme and helped bring through four-time champions Sebastian Vettel and Max Verstappen, linked the investment to his career in racing.

"Motorsport was never left to chance; it was improved through the courage to consistently use new technologies for the benefit of people. That is exactly the attitude I recognise in Lebensstimmen," Marko said in the press release.
The business was founded by Philipp Berkessy, Markus Pinter and Lukas Stern, and plans to launch its platform fully in Austria and internationally in the first quarter of 2027.

"Every person has words that should remain. With Lebensstimmen, we are making end-of-life planning personal, digital and legally secure for the first time. Today, a new culture of farewell begins, and it begins in Austria," Berkessy said.

items.originalTitle: Red Bull responds to Aston Martin F1 power unit rumours
items.summaryEn: Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that the team is not in "serious conversations" about supplying power units to another Formula 1 team, including Aston Martin.
detailZh: 红牛回应向阿斯顿·马丁供应F1动力单元的传闻
红牛车队领队梅基斯确认，车队并未就向阿斯顿·马丁或任何其他F1竞争对手供应动力单元进行认真讨论
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与比赛分析。
红牛车队领队梅基斯确认，车队并未就向另一支F1车队供应动力单元进行“认真谈判”。这其中包括阿斯顿·马丁。
这支总部位于银石的车队整个赛季都在动力单元性能上苦苦挣扎，其与本田的厂商合作关系也一直紧张。如今有报道称，阿斯顿·马丁可能在另寻他处，包括红牛和福特。
红牛本赛季的动力总成令人大感意外，其内燃机被国际汽联定义为标杆，并且已在马克斯·维斯塔潘手中拿下两场胜利。听到围场中的客户车队会对这样的动力单元感兴趣，并不会让人感到意外。在美国大奖赛期间，梅基斯承认确实存在兴趣，但这款动力单元是非卖品。
“你看，我们的引擎性能引来了大量我们不想要的正面关注，这自然也引起了众多车队的注意，”他说。
“我们有没有和任何人认真谈过为另一支车队供应动力单元？没有。我们觉得自己还没准备好。未来五年这是板上钉钉的吗？不是。因为我不知道未来五年会发生什么，但可以肯定的是，对我们来说，我们自己这边有足够的工作要做，去改进动力单元，改进它在赛车中的整合。”
梅基斯坚称，红牛动力总成内部没有人认为这台引擎已经完成。
“我之所以微笑，是因为你在红牛动力总成里很难找到一个人认为这台引擎已经搞定，”他说，“有上千项可驾驶性方面的考量，我们知道可以做得更好，也相信我们会做得更好。”
他补充说，充分发挥引擎与底盘之间协同效应的潜力，是红牛决定自研动力单元的主要原因。
“使用自家动力单元的主要原因之一，就是试图从整合中获取竞争优势，这正是我们所有人努力的方向。”
阿斯顿·马丁的迈克·克拉克也试图淡化这一想法，并确认了车队对这家日本制造商的承诺。
“我只能说我们有一个合作伙伴，一个长期合作伙伴，那就是本田，顺便说一句，本周末它已经完成了第500场比赛，而且我认为当我们一起赢得第一场比赛时，我们也会在一起，”他说。
detailEn: Red Bull responds to Aston Martin F1 power unit rumours
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed the team is not in serious discussions to supply Aston Martin or any other Formula 1 rival with power units
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies has confirmed that the team is not in "serious conversations" when it comes to supplying another Formula 1 team with power units. This includes Aston Martin.

The Silverstone-based team has struggled with its power unit performance all season as its works partnership with Honda has been strained. Now, there are reports of Aston Martin potentially looking elsewhere, including Red Bull and Ford.

Red Bull's powertrain this season has been a huge surprise, with the internal combustion engine being defined as the benchmark by the FIA, and it already securing two victories in the hands of Max Verstappen. It wouldn't come as a surprise to hear that customer teams across the grid would be interested in such a thing. Talking at the United States Grand Prix, Mekies admitted that there certainly is interest, but the power unit isn't for sale.
“Look, we got a lot of unwanted positive publicity about the performance of our engine and that came with certainly attention from a lot of teams,” he said.

“Are we having any serious conversations with anyone to supply another team? No. We don’t feel we are ready for that. Is it set in stone for the next five years? No. Because I don’t know what’s going to happen in the next five years, but for sure, for us there is enough work on our side to improve the power unit, to improve its integration in the car.”
Mekies insisted nobody at Red Bull Powertrains believes the engine is finished.

“I’m smiling because you will struggle to find one person in RBPT that thinks that the engine is sorted,” he said. “There are a thousand driveability considerations that we know we can do better, and we know we will do better.”
He added that getting the most out of the link between engine and chassis was the main reason for Red Bull building its own unit.
“One of the main reasons you use your own power unit is to try to extract a competitive advantage from its integration, and that’s what we are all working towards.”
Aston Martin’s Mike Krack also tried to calm the idea, confirming the team's commitment to the Japanese manufacturer.

“I can only say we have a partner, a long-term partner, which is Honda, that, by the way, has done its 500th race this weekend, and I think we will be together also when we win our first race together,” he said.
keyPointsZh: 梅基斯表示，红牛没有就向阿斯顿·马丁或任何其他F1竞争对手供应动力单元进行认真讨论。
keyPointsEn: Mekies said Red Bull is not in serious discussions about supplying power units to Aston Martin or any other Formula 1 rival.

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli extends F1 title lead with US GP win Mercedes didn’t expect
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在美国大奖赛中赢得F1冠军，梅赛德斯车队并未预料到这一点
安德鲁·肖夫林承认梅赛德斯车队的设置窗口非常狭窄，赞扬基米·安东内利在奥斯汀的神奇胜利
对于梅赛德斯车队的粉丝来说，这里有最新的银箭动态，包括来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
在美洲赛车场的周五练习后，梅赛德斯车队的维修区内的数据表明，布拉克利车队正准备收拾行囊，迎接一个糟糕的、毫无积分的周末。赛车落后于节奏，车手们抱怨平衡问题，最近的风力升级看起来是一个巨大的错误。
快进到周日下午，19岁的安德烈亚·基米·安东内利站在领奖台上最高的一步，喷洒着香槟，随意地扩大着他的世界冠军领先优势。
根据梅赛德斯赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林的说法，从周五有些像拖拉机一样的速度到周日的统治性胜利，这种巨大的转变简直是一场奇迹。
在赛后简报中，肖夫林对工程部门在周末的迷茫直言不讳。
“恭喜基米和布拉克利以及布里克斯沃斯的所有人赢得了胜利。在周五之后，鉴于我们的单圈和长距离速度，一场胜利看起来根本无法实现，所以这是一个惊人的转变，一个非常令人满意的结果，”肖夫林承认。
那周五事故的部分原因直接关联到乔治·拉塞尔的赛后评论。拉塞尔在完成比赛并排在较后位置后称赛车为“垃圾”，而肖夫林基本上确认了他们在马来西亚带回的备受期待的提升套件将W17变成了一个具有挑战性的机器。
虽然赛车速度有令人鼓舞的迹象，但自从更新以来，感觉调整窗口变得更加难以把握，”肖夫林承认。
微薄的调整窗口导致了梅赛德斯车手们截然不同的两场比赛。安东内利想出了如何保持车队前部的轮胎状态，而拉塞尔从发车灯亮起的那一刻起就遇到了更多的困难。
“对于乔治来说，那是一个令人沮丧的下午。第一圈偏离赛道所受的处罚没有帮助，尽管他在第二次比赛开始时有一个强劲的起步，但他被皮亚斯特里挡住，找不到突破的方法，”肖夫林指出。
在皮亚斯特里的麦克拉伦车后卡住，实际上让拉塞尔很难从第一圈的赛道限制处罚中恢复过来。
但在安东内利的车库一侧，梅赛德斯维修区在巨大压力下完美执行。当轮胎在崎岖的德克萨斯沥青上磨损加剧时，策略师们并没有恐慌，而是信任他们的数学计算。
“从操作层面来看，车队做得非常好。策略决策并不明显，但我们保持了冷静，做出了正确的决定，坚持一停策略，并且维修区停靠也很稳定，”Shovlin解释道。
最终，Shovlin将所有的赞誉都归功于他的年轻车手，这位车手成功地将一辆不可预测的车拖到了关键的赛季末胜利。
“最关键的是，基米应该对自己的表现感到非常满意。周五的比赛非常艰难，但他今天的排位赛和正赛表现都非常出色。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli extends F1 title lead with US GP win Mercedes didn’t expect
Andrew Shovlin admits Mercedes' setup window is incredibly narrow, praising Kimi Antonelli for a miracle win in Austin
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The telemetry inside the Mercedes garage after Friday practice at the Circuit of the Americas pointed towards the Brackley squad waiting to pack up for a miserable, point-less weekend. The car was off the pace, the drivers were complaining about the balance, and the recent aerodynamic upgrades looked like a massive misstep.
Fast forward to Sunday afternoon, and 19-year-old Andrea Kimi Antonelli is standing on the top step of the podium, spraying champagne and casually extending his world championship lead.
According to Mercedes trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin, the sheer whiplash of going from Friday's somewhat tractor-like pace to Sunday's dominant win was nothing short of a miracle.
During the post-race debrief, Shovlin was incredibly blunt about just how lost the engineering department was heading into the weekend.

"Well done to Kimi and everyone in Brackley and Brixworth on the win. After Friday, a race victory simply didn’t look achievable given our single-lap and long-run pace, so it’s been a remarkable turnaround and a very satisfying result," Shovlin admitted.

Part of the reason for that Friday mishap directly correlates with George Russell's post-race comments. Russell called the car "rubbish" after finishing down the order, and Shovlin essentially confirmed that the highly anticipated upgrade package they brought back in Malaysia has turned the W17 into a challenging machine.
"There were encouraging signs with the car pace, although since the update it does feel like the set-up window has become a little harder to hit," Shovlin confessed.

The razor-thin set-up window resulted in two completely different races for the Mercedes drivers. While Antonelli figured out how to keep the tyres alive at the front of the pack, Russell's afternoon was more difficult from the moment the lights went out.

"For George, it was a frustrating afternoon. The penalty for going off track on the opening lap didn’t help and, despite making a strong start to his second stint, he got stuck behind Piastri and couldn’t find a way through," Shovlin noted.
Getting stuck behind Oscar Piastri's McLaren effectively made it difficult for Russell to recover from his Lap 1 track limits penalty.

But on Antonelli's side of the garage, the Mercedes pitwall executed flawlessly under massive pressure. Instead of panicking when tyre degradation spiked on the brutally bumpy Texas asphalt, the strategists trusted their maths.

"Operationally, though, the team did a very good job. The strategy decisions weren’t clear-cut, but we held our nerve, made the right call to stick with the one-stop, and the pitstops were solid," Shovlin explained.
Ultimately, Shovlin threw all the credit to his teenage driver, who managed to drag an unpredictable car to a crucial late-season victory.
"Most of all, Kimi should be incredibly pleased with his performances. It was a difficult Friday, but what he produced in qualifying and the race today was exceptional."
keyPointsZh: 19岁的安东内利在周日赢得了比赛
这是梅赛德斯车队未曾预料到的结果
keyPointsEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the race on Sunday
This was a result Mercedes did not expect

items.titleZh: 沃尔夫为拉塞尔美国大奖赛低迷揽责
items.summaryZh: 美国大奖赛后，梅赛德斯领队托托·沃尔夫主动为乔治·拉塞尔一侧车库的巨大速度差距承担责任，而不是把责任推给车手。拉塞尔经历了一个糟糕的下午，首圈一次离奇的时间处罚和完全缺乏抓地力严重拖累了他的表现。

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff takes blame for George Russell's US GP struggles
items.summaryEn: After the United States Grand Prix, Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff took full responsibility for the massive pace deficit on George Russell's side of the garage instead of blaming his driver. Russell endured a miserable afternoon severely compromised by a bizarre first-lap time penalty and a complete lack of grip.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫为乔治·拉塞尔在美国大奖赛的低迷揽责
梅赛德斯领队没有把责任推给车手，而是为拉塞尔一侧车库的巨大速度差距承担全部责任
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的比赛分析。
如果你在美国大奖赛周日赛后看向梅赛德斯车库的两侧，你会以为他们使用的是完全不同的赛车。一侧，新星安德烈亚·基米·安东内利正在庆祝一场奇迹般、占据统治地位的胜利。另一侧，乔治·拉塞尔在一个糟糕的下午后抓狂不已，他的表现因首圈一次离奇的时间处罚和完全缺乏抓地力而严重受损。
当梅赛德斯车队老板托托·沃尔夫走到麦克风前履行赛后媒体职责时，他毫不掩饰。他立即为自己的老将车手挺身而出，在就车队的工程失误狠狠自责之前，先对国际汽联（FIA）的赛事干事开了一炮。
在赛后与大卫·库特哈德的交谈中，话题立刻转向了拉塞尔在混乱的首圈冲出赛道后收到的那个令人费解的5秒罚时。
“在维修区里是一种反应，在领奖台上是庆祝，回到维修区又是沮丧，”库特哈德描述着当时的场景说道。“我觉得那个5秒罚时，我不知道他们当时在想什么。那是第一圈的比赛。所以希望这件事能向赛事干事反映一下。”
沃尔夫毫不迟疑，立刻顺着库特哈德关于得克萨斯州奥斯汀环境的玩笑接了下去。
“这里吸烟是合法的，你知道吧，”沃尔夫面无表情地回击道。
“是啊，他们可能一直在干的就是这个，”库特哈德笑着回应，随后转向了更严肃的问题——拉塞尔相比他的新秀队友那令人费解的缺乏速度。
虽然五秒罚时确实对拉塞尔的下午没有帮助，但车手和车队都公开承认，赛车的基础速度简直糟糕透顶。库特哈德追问沃尔夫，他打算如何管理这位“优质资产”——此人目前正被姊妹车里的那个小子彻底碾压。
梅赛德斯老板没有把压力放在拉塞尔肩上，而是明确表示，工程部门辜负了一位具备冠军水准的车手。
“我的意思是，在另一边，乔治是一位冠军。我们有一个拥有一切的人，但他与赛车不合拍，”沃尔夫解释道。“我们需要找出原因，因为看到维修区另一边一个在水上行走的人，以及一个拥有全部能力却无法从赛车中提取性能的人，对我们来说并不令人满意。”
赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林已经确认，车队最新的空气动力学升级使调校窗口变得极其狭窄，沃尔夫知道修复这一混乱局面的重担完全落在指挥台和回到布拉克利的工厂身上。
“这是我们的责任，我们只是团结在一起，”沃尔夫总结道，坚定地为拉塞尔在德克萨斯的噩梦承担责任。
detailEn: Toto Wolff takes blame for George Russell's US GP struggles
Instead of throwing his driver under the bus, the Mercedes boss takes full responsibility for the massive pace deficit on Russell's side of the garage
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

If you looked at the two sides of the Mercedes garage after Sunday's United States Grand Prix, you would assume they were running completely different machinery. On one side, sensation Andrea Kimi Antonelli was celebrating a miraculous, dominant race victory. On the other, George Russell was pulling his hair out after a miserable afternoon severely compromised by a bizarre first-lap time penalty and a complete lack of grip.

When Mercedes boss Toto Wolff stepped in front of the microphones for his post-race media duties, he didn't hold back. He immediately went to bat for his veteran driver, taking a shot at the FIA stewards before brutally falling on his own sword regarding the team's engineering failures.
During a post-race chat with David Coulthard, the conversation immediately shifted to the baffling five-second time penalty Russell received for going off track during the chaotic opening lap.

"One at the garage, celebration on the stage, on the garage, frustration," Coulthard noted, setting the scene. "I think the five-second penalty was, I'm not sure what they were smoking. This was racing on the first lap. So hopefully that gets spoken to the stewards about."
Without missing a beat, Wolff immediately leaned into Coulthard's joke about the Austin, Texas environment.
"It's legal here to smoke, you know," Wolff fired back with a deadpan delivery.
"Yeah, that's maybe what they've been doing," Coulthard laughed before pivoting to the much more serious issue of Russell's baffling lack of pace compared to his rookie team-mate.

While a five-second penalty certainly didn't help Russell's afternoon, both the driver and the team have openly admitted the car's underlying pace was simply rubbish. Coulthard pressed Wolff on how he plans to manage a "quality asset" who is currently getting absolutely blown out of the water by the kid in the sister car.
Instead of putting the pressure on Russell's shoulders, the Mercedes boss made it abundantly clear that the engineering department is failing a championship-calibre driver.

"I mean, on the other side with George, we have a champion. We have someone that has it all, but he's not clicking with the car," Wolff explained. "And we need to find out why that is, because it's not for us satisfying to see someone that walks on water on the other side of the garage, and a guy who, with all his ability, not being able to extract the performance out of the car."

With trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin already confirming that the team's latest aerodynamic upgrades have made the set-up window insanely narrow, Wolff knows the burden of fixing this mess rests entirely on the pitwall and the factory back in Brackley.
"And this is on us, and we're just together," Wolff concluded, firmly taking the blame for Russell's Texas nightmare.

items.originalTitle: Valtteri Bottas denies he might lose his Cadillac seat for F1 2027
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯否认他可能失去2027年凯迪拉克赛车席位
凯迪拉克的Marcin Budkowski拒绝确认他的车手是否会留任
瓦尔特里·博塔斯坚称凯迪拉克对他很满意，他的合同“一切正常”至2027年，尽管最近有关他F1未来的传闻。
博塔斯最近在资格赛和比赛中缺乏速度，导致对车手市场的猜测。媒体提到，在哈斯车队失去座位的奥康，由于在F2锦标赛中的表现，被认为是博塔斯席位的有力竞争者；同样，凯迪拉克测试车手Colton Herta和红牛车队预备车手角田裕毅也被视为潜在竞争者。
在这种情况下，凯迪拉克车队负责人Marcin Budkoswki——他在这个职位上已经工作了两个半月——在美国大奖赛的周五新闻发布会上被问及奥康是否可能是预备角色的候选人——而他的回答含糊不清。
“嗯，看吧，作为一个车队负责人，我相信我的同事也是这样，你会在市场上接到每个车手或车手经理的电话和联系。”Budkowski说。“所以，有很多人和经理联系了我。我不会说是谁或者不是谁，但基本上所有在市场上的人都已经联系过了，就像你们想象的那样。
“但是，是的，我认为这里是我最不愿意透露车手阵容的地方，就像你们想象的那样。如果那样做，我的市场和传播部门会杀了我的。”
当被追问博塔斯和塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯是否真的有2027年的有效合同时，这位波兰人神秘地补充说：“再次强调，这是我最不愿意评论车手合同的地方，总的来说，我认为这不是在新闻发布会上做的事情。这是在适当的时候由车队官方发布时才会做的事情。”
瓦尔特里·博塔斯，凯迪拉克车队，与车队负责人马辛·布德科夫斯基交谈
由于两位车手在加入凯迪拉克车队时都签署了‘多年’合同，因此不清楚在加入凯迪拉克车队后，是否需要满足某些条件（如果有的话）才能触发他们2027年的合同延期
据信奥康正朝着与阿斯顿·马丁的预备合同前进，而不是凯迪拉克的工作，但博塔斯的座位是否必然安全？
当被问及车队是否向他保证了2027年的合同时，这位264场比赛的老将说：‘是的——我的意思是，去年我签合同时，我知道条款，所以一切都很好。’
被Motorsport.com就布杜科夫斯基周五的评论以及他是否对那些模棱两可的回答感到惊讶进行追问时，博塔斯表示他既不知道那些评论，也不在意。
至于有没有任何情况下，尽管理论上他签订了2027赛季的合同，但他不会为凯迪拉克赛车，博塔斯沉思道：“我的意思是，这是一级方程式。如果牛能飞，你知道……在这个运动中，任何事情都可能发生。但现在，他们似乎对我所做的一切都很满意。我认为那才是最重要的。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas denies he might lose his Cadillac seat for F1 2027
As Cadillac’s Marcin Budkowski refuses to confirm his drivers are staying on next year, Bottas insists he’s got a valid contract
Valtteri Bottas insists Cadillac is happy with him and his contract is “all OK” for 2027, amid recent rumours about his Formula 1 future.

Bottas’ recent lack of both qualifying and race pace has led to speculation on the driver market. Esteban Ocon, who lost his seat to Formula 2 championship leader Rafael Camara at Haas, was brought up in the media as a potential contender for the Finn’s seat; so were Cadillac test driver Colton Herta, despite his tough F2 season, and Red Bull reserve driver Yuki Tsunoda.

In that context, Cadillac team principal Marcin Budkoswki – who has been in office for two-and-a-half months – was asked, in Friday’s press conference at the United States Grand Prix, if Ocon might be a candidate for a reserve role – and his answer was elusive.

“Well, look, as a team principal, and I’m sure it’s the same with my colleagues, you’re getting calls and contacts from every driver or driver manager that is on the market,” Budkowski said. “So, there are a number of drivers and managers who have contacted me. I’m not going to say who it is or who it isn’t, but pretty much all of them that are on the market have been in touch, as you’d expect.
“But yes, I think it’s the last place here, as you can imagine, where I would communicate anything on driver line-up. My marketing and communications department would kill me if I did that.”

Pressed on whether Bottas and Sergio Perez did have valid contracts for 2027, the Pole intriguingly added: “Again, this is the last place I would comment on driver contracts, and in general, I think it’s not something that is done in the press. It’s something which will be done by official releases from the team when the time is right.”
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac Racing, speaks to team principal Marcin Budkowski
Given both drivers signed ‘multi-year’ contracts when they joined Cadillac for 2026, it’s unclear what conditions – if any – must be met to trigger their 2027 extensions.
Ocon is believed to be heading towards an Aston Martin reserve deal rather than the Cadillac gig anyway, but is Bottas’ seat necessarily secure?
Asked if the team had given him reassurance for 2027, the 264-race veteran said: “Yes – I mean, last year when I signed, I know the terms, so that's all OK.”
Pressed by Motorsport.com on Budkowski’s Friday comments and whether he was surprised by those equivocal answers, Bottas said he was both unaware of those remarks and unbothered.

As to whether there was any scenario where he wouldn’t be racing for Cadillac despite theoretically having a contract for 2027 season, Bottas pondered: “I mean, it is Formula 1. If cows could fly, you know… anything can always happen in this sport. But for now, they seem happy with what they're getting out of me. I think that's all that matters.”
